idea-plugin.name: MSBuild Binlog Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Open .binlog files in Rider using a dedicated viewer designed for fast inspection.

  • Browse Build / Project / Target / Task / Message nodes as a tree
  • Filter the tree by text
  • Inspect the selected node in a compact properties panel

The plugin parses MSBuild binary logs via a bundled .NET helper powered by MSBuild.StructuredLogger.

A local dotnet runtime or SDK is required.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial public release of the Rider-native MSBuild binlog viewer.
